description: Na₂BiO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four BiO₆ octahedra, edges with four BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four BiO₆ octahedra, edges with four BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.58 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with five BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-4°. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.16 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent BiO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 12-13°. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and four longer (2.38 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-11°. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Bi₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-10°.
